    81	RankRange rankRange(const std::size_t total, const int rank, const int ranks) noexcept {
    82	    const std::size_t rankCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks);
    83	    const std::size_t rankIndex = static_cast<std::size_t>(rank);
    84	    const std::size_t quotient = total / rankCount;
    85	    const std::size_t remainder = total % rankCount;
    86	    return {quotient * rankIndex + std::min(rankIndex, remainder),
    87	            quotient + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1U : 0U)};
    88	}

    90	__device__ __forceinline__ double cumulativeNormal(const double x) noexcept {
    91	    return 0.5 * (1.0 + erf(x * kInvSqrt2));
    92	}
    93	
    94	__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
    95	void blackScholesKernel(const double* __restrict__ fields,
    96	                        const int* __restrict__ types,
    97	                        double* __restrict__ results,
    98	                        const std::size_t count) {
    99	    const double* const strike = fields + STRIKE * count;
   100	    const double* const spot = fields + SPOT * count;
   101	    const double* const q = fields + DIVIDEND_YIELD * count;
   102	    const double* const r = fields + RISK_FREE_RATE * count;
   103	    const double* const t = fields + TIME_TO_MATURITY * count;
   104	    const double* const vol = fields + VOLATILITY * count;
   105	
   106	    const std::size_t first = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   107	    const std::size_t stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
   108	    for (std::size_t i = first; i < count; i += stride) {
   109	        const double maturity = t[i];
   110	        const double sigma = vol[i];
   111	        if (maturity <= 0.0 || sigma <= 0.0) {
   112	            results[i] = 0.0;
   113	            continue;
   114	        }
   115	
   116	        const double rootT = sqrt(maturity);
   117	        const double sigmaRootT = sigma * rootT;
   118	        const double d1 = (log(spot[i] / strike[i]) +
   119	                           (r[i] - q[i] + 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * maturity) /
   120	                          sigmaRootT;
   121	        const double d2 = d1 - sigmaRootT;
   122	        const double discountR = exp(-r[i] * maturity);
   123	        const double discountQ = exp(-q[i] * maturity);
   124	
   125	        if (types[i] == CALL) {
   126	            results[i] = spot[i] * discountQ * cumulativeNormal(d1) -
   127	                         strike[i] * discountR * cumulativeNormal(d2);
   128	        } else {
   129	            results[i] = strike[i] * discountR * cumulativeNormal(-d2) -
   130	                         spot[i] * discountQ * cumulativeNormal(-d1);
   131	        }
   132	    }
   133	}

   145	    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
   146	        return false;
   147	    }
   148	    errno = 0;
   149	    char* end = nullptr;
   150	    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
   151	    if (errno == ERANGE || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
   152	        parsed > static_cast<unsigned long long>(std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max())) {
   153	        return false;
   154	    }
   155	    value = static_cast<std::size_t>(parsed);
   156	    return value <= std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max() / FIELD_COUNT;

+void blackScholesKernel(const double* __restrict__ fields,

+    const double* const strike = fields + STRIKE * count;
+    const double* const spot = fields + SPOT * count;
+    const double* const q = fields + DIVIDEND_YIELD * count;
+    const double* const r = fields + RISK_FREE_RATE * count;

+    for (std::size_t i = first; i < count; i += stride) {
+        const double maturity = t[i];
+        const double sigma = vol[i];
+        if (maturity <= 0.0 || sigma <= 0.0) {

+            continue;

+bool prepareDevice(DeviceWork& work, const double* hostFields,
+                   const int* hostTypes, const std::size_t rankCount,
+                   const int rank) {
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaSetDevice(work.device), "cudaSetDevice", rank, work.device) ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaFree(nullptr), "CUDA context initialization", rank, work.device)) {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    int multiprocessors = 1;
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&multiprocessors,
+                                                 cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount,
+                                                 work.device),
+                         "cudaDeviceGetAttribute", rank, work.device)) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    const std::size_t neededBlocks =
+        (work.count + static_cast<std::size_t>(kThreadsPerBlock) - 1U) /
+        static_cast<std::size_t>(kThreadsPerBlock);
+    work.blocks = static_cast<int>(std::max<std::size_t>(
+        1U, std::min<std::size_t>(neededBlocks,
+                                  static_cast<std::size_t>(multiprocessors) * kBlocksPerSm)));
+
+    if (work.count == 0) {
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    const std::size_t fieldBytes = work.count * FIELD_COUNT * sizeof(double);
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&work.fields), fieldBytes),
+                         "cudaMalloc(option fields)", rank, work.device) ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&work.types),
+                                    work.count * sizeof(int)),
+                         "cudaMalloc(option types)", rank, work.device) ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&work.results),
+                                    work.count * sizeof(double)),
+                         "cudaMalloc(results)", rank, work.device)) {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t field = 0; field < FIELD_COUNT; ++field) {
+        const double* source = hostFields + field * rankCount + work.localOffset;
+        double* destination = work.fields + field * work.count;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(destination, source,
+                                        work.count * sizeof(double),
+                                        cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                             "cudaMemcpy(option fields)", rank, work.device)) {
+            return false;
+        }
     }
+    return reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(work.types,
+                                      hostTypes + work.localOffset,
+                                      work.count * sizeof(int),
+                                      cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                           "cudaMemcpy(option types)", rank, work.device);
+}

+bool runDevice(DeviceWork& work, const int rank) {
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaSetDevice(work.device), "cudaSetDevice", rank, work.device)) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (work.count != 0) {
+        blackScholesKernel<<<work.blocks, kThreadsPerBlock>>>(
+            work.fields, work.types, work.results, work.count);
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaGetLastError(), "Black-Scholes kernel launch",
+                             rank, work.device)) {
+            return false;
+        }
+    }
+    return reportCudaError(cudaDeviceSynchronize(), "Black-Scholes kernel execution",
+                           rank, work.device);
+}
+
+void releaseDevice(DeviceWork& work) noexcept {
+    cudaSetDevice(work.device);
+    cudaFree(work.results);
+    cudaFree(work.types);
+    cudaFree(work.fields);
+    work.results = nullptr;
+    work.types = nullptr;
+    work.fields = nullptr;
+}
+
+void gatherResults(const std::vector<double>& local, std::vector<double>& global,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const RankRange own = rankRange(total, rank, ranks);
+    if (total <= static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+        std::vector<int> counts;
+        std::vector<int> displacements;
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            counts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+            displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+            for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+                const RankRange range = rankRange(total, source, ranks);
+                counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(range.count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(range.offset);
+            }
+        }
+        MPI_Gatherv(local.data(), static_cast<int>(own.count), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    rank == 0 ? global.data() : nullptr,
+                    rank == 0 ? counts.data() : nullptr,
+                    rank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr,
+                    MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        return;
+    }
+
+    constexpr std::size_t kMaxMessage = static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX);
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        std::copy(local.begin(), local.end(), global.begin() + own.offset);
+        for (int source = 1; source < ranks; ++source) {
+            const RankRange range = rankRange(total, source, ranks);
+            for (std::size_t received = 0; received < range.count;) {
+                const std::size_t chunk = std::min(kMaxMessage, range.count - received);
+                MPI_Recv(global.data() + range.offset + received, static_cast<int>(chunk),
+                         MPI_DOUBLE, source, kMpiResultTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                         MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);
+                received += chunk;
+            }
+        }
+    } else {
+        for (std::size_t sent = 0; sent < own.count;) {
+            const std::size_t chunk = std::min(kMaxMessage, own.count - sent);
+            MPI_Send(local.data() + sent, static_cast<int>(chunk), MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                     kMpiResultTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+            sent += chunk;
+        }
+    }
 }

codex
Implemented the hybrid benchmark while preserving the `black_scholes` executable name.

- MPI partitions options across ranks and reports slowest-rank timing.
- OpenMP performs NUMA-aware input generation and multi-GPU orchestration.
- CUDA uses coalesced structure-of-arrays data and an occupancy-limited grid-stride kernel.
- GPUs are assigned safely among node-local MPI ranks.
- Full MPI result gathering occurs only for `-r`; validation transfers only required values.
- CMake now requires MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA and generates native GPU code.

Modified:

- [black_scholes.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/black-scholes_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_hybrid_r1/black-scholes/black_scholes.cpp)
- [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/black-scholes_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_hybrid_r1/black-scholes/CMakeLists.txt)

Verified clean compilation, native `sm_86` generation, single- and four-rank execution, validation/output ordering, zero-sized inputs, and ranks with empty partitions. CUDA results agreed with the original CPU formula within approximately `3.1e-15`. No new source files remain.

+void blackScholesKernel(const double* __restrict__ fields,
+                        const int* __restrict__ types,
+                        double* __restrict__ results,
+                        const std::size_t count) {
+    const double* const strike = fields + STRIKE * count;
+    const double* const spot = fields + SPOT * count;
+    const double* const q = fields + DIVIDEND_YIELD * count;
+    const double* const r = fields + RISK_FREE_RATE * count;
+    const double* const t = fields + TIME_TO_MATURITY * count;
+    const double* const vol = fields + VOLATILITY * count;

+    const std::size_t first = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const std::size_t stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (std::size_t i = first; i < count; i += stride) {
+        const double maturity = t[i];
+        const double sigma = vol[i];
+        if (maturity <= 0.0 || sigma <= 0.0) {
+            results[i] = 0.0;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const double rootT = sqrt(maturity);
+        const double sigmaRootT = sigma * rootT;
+        const double d1 = (log(spot[i] / strike[i]) +
+                           (r[i] - q[i] + 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * maturity) /
+                          sigmaRootT;
+        const double d2 = d1 - sigmaRootT;
+        const double discountR = exp(-r[i] * maturity);
+        const double discountQ = exp(-q[i] * maturity);
+
+        if (types[i] == CALL) {
+            results[i] = spot[i] * discountQ * cumulativeNormal(d1) -
+                         strike[i] * discountR * cumulativeNormal(d2);
+        } else {
+            results[i] = strike[i] * discountR * cumulativeNormal(-d2) -
+                         spot[i] * discountQ * cumulativeNormal(-d1);
+        }
     }

+                   const int* hostTypes, const std::size_t rankCount,

+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaSetDevice(work.device), "cudaSetDevice", rank, work.device) ||
+        !reportCudaError(cudaFree(nullptr), "CUDA context initialization", rank, work.device)) {

+        !reportCudaError(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&work.results),
+                                    work.count * sizeof(double)),
+                         "cudaMalloc(results)", rank, work.device)) {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    for (std::size_t field = 0; field < FIELD_COUNT; ++field) {
+        const double* source = hostFields + field * rankCount + work.localOffset;
+        double* destination = work.fields + field * work.count;
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(destination, source,
+                                        work.count * sizeof(double),
+                                        cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                             "cudaMemcpy(option fields)", rank, work.device)) {
+            return false;
+        }
     }
+    return reportCudaError(cudaMemcpy(work.types,
+                                      hostTypes + work.localOffset,
+                                      work.count * sizeof(int),
+                                      cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
+                           "cudaMemcpy(option types)", rank, work.device);
+}
+
+bool runDevice(DeviceWork& work, const int rank) {
+    if (!reportCudaError(cudaSetDevice(work.device), "cudaSetDevice", rank, work.device)) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (work.count != 0) {
+        blackScholesKernel<<<work.blocks, kThreadsPerBlock>>>(
+            work.fields, work.types, work.results, work.count);
+        if (!reportCudaError(cudaGetLastError(), "Black-Scholes kernel launch",
+                             rank, work.device)) {
+            return false;
+        }
+    }
+    return reportCudaError(cudaDeviceSynchronize(), "Black-Scholes kernel execution",
+                           rank, work.device);
+}
+
+void releaseDevice(DeviceWork& work) noexcept {
+    cudaSetDevice(work.device);
+    cudaFree(work.results);
+    cudaFree(work.types);
+    cudaFree(work.fields);
+    work.results = nullptr;
+    work.types = nullptr;
+    work.fields = nullptr;
+}

+void gatherResults(const std::vector<double>& local, std::vector<double>& global,
+                   const std::size_t total, const int rank, const int ranks) {
+    const RankRange own = rankRange(total, rank, ranks);
+    if (total <= static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+        std::vector<int> counts;
+        std::vector<int> displacements;
+        if (rank == 0) {
+            counts.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+            displacements.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(ranks));
+            for (int source = 0; source < ranks; ++source) {
+                const RankRange range = rankRange(total, source, ranks);
+                counts[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(range.count);
+                displacements[static_cast<std::size_t>(source)] = static_cast<int>(range.offset);
+            }
+        }
+        MPI_Gatherv(local.data(), static_cast<int>(own.count), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                    rank == 0 ? global.data() : nullptr,
+                    rank == 0 ? counts.data() : nullptr,
+                    rank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr,
+                    MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        return;
+    }
+
+    constexpr std::size_t kMaxMessage = static_cast<std::size_t>(INT_MAX);
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        std::copy(local.begin(), local.end(), global.begin() + own.offset);
+        for (int source = 1; source < ranks; ++source) {
+            const RankRange range = rankRange(total, source, ranks);
+            for (std::size_t received = 0; received < range.count;) {
+                const std::size_t chunk = std::min(kMaxMessage, range.count - received);
+                MPI_Recv(global.data() + range.offset + received, static_cast<int>(chunk),
+                         MPI_DOUBLE, source, kMpiResultTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                         MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);
+                received += chunk;
+            }
+        }
+    } else {
+        for (std::size_t sent = 0; sent < own.count;) {
+            const std::size_t chunk = std::min(kMaxMessage, own.count - sent);
+            MPI_Send(local.data() + sent, static_cast<int>(chunk), MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
+                     kMpiResultTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+            sent += chunk;
+        }
+    }
 }

Implemented the hybrid benchmark while preserving the `black_scholes` executable name.

- MPI partitions options across ranks and reports slowest-rank timing.
- OpenMP performs NUMA-aware input generation and multi-GPU orchestration.
- CUDA uses coalesced structure-of-arrays data and an occupancy-limited grid-stride kernel.
- GPUs are assigned safely among node-local MPI ranks.
- Full MPI result gathering occurs only for `-r`; validation transfers only required values.
- CMake now requires MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA and generates native GPU code.
